title: Re-using plastic cassettes for vertical gel electrophoresis.
protocol: Clean plastic gel plates with 70 % ethanol.
Place the tall plate on the lab bench.
Pipette 2-3 ml of 1 % liquefied agarose along the outside part of the plate.
Carefully place the short plate onto the tall plate.
Lift up the cassette while holding it levelled and apply foldback clips.
Check whether the outside part of the cassette is well filled with agarose after the agarose has solidified.
If the outside part is not well filled, pipette from the outside agarose in-between the plates.
Re-apply the foldback clips if necessary.
Remove any agarose that has leaked into the inside of the cassette using a piece of paper towel or Whatman Blotting paper.
Tape scotch tape over the slot at the bottom of the tall gel plate.
Fold one end of the tape for easier removal later.
Pour premix acrylamide solutions, APS, and TEMED into the cassette to cast an SDS-PAGE gradient gel.
Allow the acrylamide gel to solidify completely.
Remove the comb and scotch tape from the gel plate.
Carefully remove foldback clips and rinse with deionised water.
Mount the gel cassette into the electrophoresis unit carefully.
